message: The 'shows no success when the reopen fails' test asserts the snackbar was not called right after the mutation spy fires, with no observable state to wait on. If the success toast ran a tick later, or the failure mock did not actually reject, the test would still pass.
canReopen ignores whether the training's questionnaire is open, so a reopen in a closed training leaves the household with nothing to edit and the goal blocked from Run & Send.
The first Menu child is RunAndSendTooltip, which drops the autoFocus and tabIndex MUI clones onto the active child, so keyboard users cannot reach either menu item.

This PR selects new API fields and mutations (reopenNewStaffQuestionnaire, setNewStaffCohortQuestionnaireDeadline, questionnaireDeadline, questionnaireLocked, questionnaireReopenedAt, deadline, locked) that exist only in the unmerged mpdx_api PR #3830. The PR has no "Staging API" label, so codegen runs against production and fails.
dismissalDetail: the Staging API label is Jeff's call, as on #2311 and #2312; the API PR #3830 ships with this one under the NSO hold

message: readOnly comes from the lock in one query result and is never rechecked, so a page left open past the deadline stays editable while the API rejects every save.
dismissalDetail: a page left open past the deadline gets the API's clear refusal on save, and the next load shows the locked view

message: The reopen success test never asserts that the attendee list is refetched, though handleReopen relies on refetchQueries because the payload lacks goalStatus. Dropping refetchQueries keeps every test green while rows keep a stale goalStatus.
The reopen failure test asserts no toast right after the request is seen, before the rejection settles, and the success test never checks the cache or refetch.
The reopen payload omits goalStatus and the refetch is not awaited, so the row briefly still looks Ready to Send after a reopen.
attendeeToRow tests were loosened from toEqual to toMatchObject instead of adding the three new fields, so the new mappings are unasserted.
dismissalDetail: the new fields are mapped through attendeeToRow in QuestionnaireLockChip.test; the helper test grows past the CodeScene file limit otherwise

message: Any locked questionnaire gets the deadline-passed copy, but a sent-goal lock can carry a future deadline and cannot be reopened.
SummaryIntro hides itself for a locked, unsubmitted questionnaire, but the API also locks once the goal is sent, so a sent household with no deadline gets no explanation at all.

canReopen has three inputs (locked, Completed, sent) but only the Completed default row is enabled in a test. A deadline-locked in-progress row, the main reopen case, is never shown as enabled, so removing the questionnaireLocked clause would go unnoticed.
A success snackbar fires after every reopen, and another after every deadline save or removal. The rules prefer letting the updated UI communicate success.
dismissalDetail: matches the questionnaire switch's success toast on the same Admin Table

message: A reopened row gets a disabled kebab whose tooltip says inputs and training costs are missing, when the real reason is that the household is still editing.
Each row now mounts its own Menu, Confirmation, snackbar hook and mutation hook instead of one shared table-level menu.
dismissalDetail: a page holds 5 to 25 rows; a menu per row keeps GoalsTable under its size limit

message: QuestionnaireDeadlineDialog and the picker code are imported statically, unlike the sibling modals in CohortBar that use next/dynamic.
dismissalDetail: the dialog is small and opens from a link, so a static import costs little

message: The two-field dialog uses useState with hand-written validation instead of the repo's Formik + Yup convention.
dismissalDetail: two fields with one rule; Formik would add more than it saves

message: pickerValueToDeadline is tested only on one winter and one summer date, with no DST boundary (spring-forward gap or fall-back overlap). A time entered in the nonexistent 2:30 AM hour would silently shift.
dismissalDetail: the MPD team sets deadlines in late afternoon Eastern, far from the 2 AM DST change

message: The Eastern wall time round-trips through the viewer's zone, so a time inside the viewer's DST gap shifts an hour before it is read as Eastern.
dismissalDetail: same as #18: a 2 AM deadline on a DST change day is not a real case

message: The new .graphql files are named after the operation, not the component, which the root CLAUDE.md rule asks for.
dismissalDetail: matches the sibling SetNewStaffCohortQuestionnaireOpen.graphql, named after its operation
